title: Proposed PQ explorer RPC request and result fragments
description: Design-only schemas, not a shipped API. Select a $defs fragment to validate it. Native semantic checks remain mandatory. Definitions are closed in v1; clients must tolerate additive unknown fields outside these validated fragments.

U64.description: Native parser must enforce <=18446744073709551615; string pattern alone does not prove range.

Bytes.description: Standard padded base64; canonical pad bits and decoded budgets require native checks.

Bits256.description: Exactly 32 decoded bytes; native parser must also enforce canonical pad bits.

RawAddress.description: Workchain must fit int32; canonical normalization requires native validation.

SignatureRequest.description: Full selector equality and non-genesis constraints also apply to block_id.
